title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5351 Lapalco Boulevard in Marrero, Louisiana, as the "Lionel R. Collins, Sr. Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5351 Lapalco Boulevard in Marrero, Louisiana, as the "Lionel R. Collins, Sr. Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Postal Service building in Marrero, Louisiana after Lionel R. Collins, Sr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5351 Lapalco Boulevard in Marrero, Louisiana. The building will be officially called the "Lionel R. Collins, Sr. Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 13, 2016.
